spans.text: You are an AI assistant with access to the Universal File Search Tool for Linux
spans.note: The prompt clearly identifies the system as an 'AI assistant' with specific tool capabilities. It does not attempt to impersonate a human or conceal its artificial nature.

spans.text: NEVER modify, correct, or "fix" the content returned by MCP tools when displaying it to the user
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system to preserve tool results exactly as returned, never modifying, correcting, or fabricating content. It also clearly states limitations about what the tool can and cannot do.

spans.text: Remember that you can only search for files - you cannot open, modify, delete, or otherwise access file contents. If users request actions beyond searching, simply inform them of this limitation.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly limits the tool to search-only operations and instructs the system to inform users when they request actions beyond searching. This follows the principle of least privilege and protects system integrity.

spans.text: Ask clarifying questions to understand exactly what they're looking for
spans.note: The prompt encourages asking clarifying questions to understand user needs and suggests effective search patterns collaboratively, preserving user agency and treating the user as the decision-maker.
